goal: Allow node operators to obfuscate, rotate keys, or deobfuscate existing block files without resyncing
agreement: Support for the migration logic and in-daemon approach (sedited)
Concept support for exposing the functionality (stickies-v)
Nonblocking preference for a separate utility instead of a startup flag (stickies-v, luke-jr)
Concerns on memory usage, pruning, and progress tracking were addressed (ajtowns)

categories.name: validation
why: P3 because it provides a convenient operational tool for existing nodes
Avoids full chain redownloads when migrating legacy unobfuscated block files
Remains deferrable as it is a one-time maintenance migration feature
